name: grove
description: Grove — one window for every feature: Claude, logs and a shell per worktree

scripts.icon: npx electron build/render-icon.js && cd build && rm -rf grove.iconset && mkdir grove.iconset && for s in 16 32 128 256 512; do sips -z $s $s icon-1024.png --out grove.iconset/icon_${s}x${s}.png >/dev/null; sips -z $((s*2)) $((s*2)) icon-1024.png --out grove.iconset/icon_${s}x${s}@2x.png >/dev/null; done && iconutil -c icns grove.iconset -o icon.icns
scripts.dist: npm run build && node scripts/stamp-version.js && npx @electron/packager . Grove --platform=darwin --icon=build/icon.icns --out=out --overwrite --no-asar --app-bundle-id=com.ramki.grove --app-category-type=public.app-category.developer-tools --ignore='^/(build|out|scripts|renderer/app\.jsx|renderer/styles\.css|node_modules)' && scripts/sign-app.sh out/Grove-darwin-*/Grove.app
scripts.install-app: npm run dist && rm -rf /Applications/Grove.app && cp -R out/Grove-darwin-*/Grove.app /Applications/
